title: Generic local packet decomposition

sub-packet validator (independent validation, evidence IDs, F1 failure class exposure)
prompt_packet.py uses decomposer when F3 recommends decomposition

required_gates.gate: decomposition improves packets on unseen same-shape prompts

required_gates.command: ripgrep packet_templates for A1-A10/Set A/4R tokens in conditional context
pytest: each sub-packet passes/fails on its own
